Pokemon. In Gens 1 and 2 it was really fun to discover new Pokemon and moves. Every time you saw something new, you immediately started to think about how you could fit it into your team, whether it was any good or fun to use, and a million other little things that made it really fun to play the first time. Gen 2 kept this up because it was the first time you saw the Pokemon universe expanded beyond the original Gen 1 and added quite a few Pokemon and moves that went well beyond Gen 1. By the time that Gen 3 came around, you already knew the moves and Pokemon so you just went for what was good. The only time that I've felt this even a bit since is when Gen 5 closed off all previous Pokemon until you beat it, which forced you to go through that discovery process again even if you'd been playing the game for a decade plus.

Don't get me wrong, I love playing Pokemon. I have 300+ hours in Pokemon X (plus all the time spent in previous games that I transferred Pokemon from), but nowadays I play it for the mechanics and multiplayer, not the discovery aspect.
